title: Ukban bar Nechemyah, the Exilarch
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He lived in Rav Yosef’s time. Hyman identifies him with Natan deTzutzita, the penitent mentioned in Shabbat 56b; see his entry.
In Bava Batra 55, Rabbah said, “Ukban bar Nechemyah told me these three things in Shmuel’s name.”

notes.text: The identification with Natan deTzutzita is Hyman’s assertion and also appears in the checked Shabbat56b paragraph.
